store.summary: A pocket-sized amateur-radio transceiver controller for Square SDR 2.
store.description: Put a real amateur-radio station in your pocket. Square SDR turns Cardputer Zero into a compact controller for the Square SDR 2 from Wide Servis, with live IQ reception, USB/LSB/AM/CW, a moving panadapter and waterfall, LED-style S meter, auto notch and RIT. Hold Tab or Space to transmit voice (built-in or USB microphone) or CW, with a mic level meter, adjustable drive, mic gain and low cut. Transmit is limited to UK amateur allocations, drops after 3 minutes or on retune, and has SWR protection. Tune 0 to 30 MHz. Direct Ethernet to the radio is the only tested connection; always test transmit on a dummy load and only transmit if you hold the appropriate licence.

ja.summary: Square SDR 2 用の送受信対応 SDR 操作アプリ。
ja.description: Cardputer Zero から Ethernet 経由で Square SDR 2 を操作します。ライブ受信、USB/LSB/AM/CW、パナアダプター、Sメーター、オートノッチ、RIT、音声/CW送信に対応します。送信は英国のアマチュア割り当て内に制限され、ダミーロードでの試験を推奨します。

zh-CN.description: 通过以太网在 Cardputer Zero 上控制 Square SDR 2。支持实时接收、USB/LSB/AM/CW、频谱瀑布图、S 表、自动陷波、RIT 以及语音/CW 发射。发射仅限英国业余频段，建议先使用假负载测试。

es.summary: Controlador SDR de recepción y transmisión para Square SDR 2.
es.description: Controla un Square SDR 2 por Ethernet desde Cardputer Zero. Recepción en directo, USB/LSB/AM/CW, panadapter y cascada, S-meter, filtro notch automático, RIT y transmisión de voz/CW. La transmisión se limita a las bandas de aficionado del Reino Unido; prueba primero con una carga ficticia.
